user: and for a bill instead?
answer:
Here’s how to add a bill in Niural Pay:

1) Go to Niural Pay → Bills → Add bill. A template selector sits next to the title.
2) Use the Upload vendor invoice panel on the right to quickly capture details by dropping the vendor’s document (JPEG, PNG, or PDF, up to 10MB). Niural extracts vendor, amount, dates, and other details automatically; review and confirm the fields.
3) To fill manually:
   - Choose the vendor you want to pay, or + Add new vendor.
   - Pick the Contract to bill against (enables anomaly check).
   - Enter Entity and department.
   - Fill Invoice details: Invoice number, Invoice date, Invoice currency, Due date.
   - Add Line items: Item, Quantity, Rate, Tax %, Discount %, Amount. Add more rows as needed; totals update automatically.
   - Add Notes (up to 500 characters) and any Additional attachments.
4) Click Next: Review details, check the summary, and confirm.
5) The bill will appear with its own Invoice ID alongside the vendor’s number. If an approval policy applies it lands under Needs approval; otherwise it moves toward Ready for payment. Paying is a separate step—open the bill and use Pay invoice.

If you’d like, you can also add a new vendor during bill creation by selecting + Add new vendor from inside the Add bill form and then return to the bill.

user: How do I add a vendor?
answer:
To add a vendor in Niural Pay:

1) Go to Niural Pay → Vendors → Add vendor (or + Add new vendor from inside the Add bill form).
2) In General information, choose the vendor type (Individual or Business), vendor country, vendor name (the legal registered name), Entity, and Department.
3) Provide Contact information: contact number and email address.
4) Under Tax & compliance details, enter the EIN and upload the Tax document if you’ll generate 1099s.
5) In the Vendor agreement, upload the contract (PDF, DOC, or DOCX).
6) Under KYB verification, tick “Mark this vendor as KYB verified” after the check has run.
7) Add Home or business address and Mailing address.
8) Click Create vendor.

That’s it—the vendor is created and can be used to attach bills.

user: and for a bill instead?
answer:
You can add a vendor bill in Niural Pay either by uploading the vendor invoice or by entering the details manually.

Option 1 — Upload the vendor invoice:
- Go to Niural Pay → Bills → Add bill, then use the Upload vendor invoice panel on the right.
- Drop the vendor document (JPEG, PNG, or PDF, up to 10MB). Niural extracts vendor, amount, dates, and other details automatically. Review and confirm the extracted fields.

Option 2 — Fill in the bill manually:
1) Choose the vendor you want to pay, or + Add new vendor.
2) Pick the contract to bill against (enables the anomaly check; use when a contract exists).
3) Enter Entity and department.
4) Invoice details — Invoice number, Invoice date, Invoice currency, Due date.
5) Line items — Item, Quantity, Rate, Tax %, Discount %, Amount. Add more items as needed; totals update as you go.
6) Add Notes (up to 500 characters) and any Additional attachments.
7) Click Next: Review details, check the summary, and confirm.

After you confirm, the bill appears with its own Invoice ID and status. If an approval policy applies, it will show under Needs approval; otherwise it moves toward Ready for payment. Paying the bill is a separate step (open the bill and use Pay invoice).

user: How do I add a vendor?
answer:
To add a vendor: go to Niural Pay → Vendors → Add vendor (or use + Add new vendor from inside the Add bill form). Then fill the vendor details:
- General information: Vendor type (Individual or Business), Vendor country, Vendor name (legal registered name), Entity, Department
- Contact information: Contact number, Email address
- Tax & compliance: EIN and a Tax document (needed if you’ll generate 1099s)
- Vendor agreement: Upload contract (PDF/DOC/DOCX)
- KYB verification: If you’ve run the check, mark the vendor as KYB verified
- Addresses: Home or business and Mailing address
Finally click Create vendor.

Tip: You can start from the Add bill flow and choose + Add new vendor there if needed.
sources: Part 2 — Niural Pay > How to add a vendor

user: and for a bill instead?
answer:
Here’s how to add a vendor bill in Niural Pay:

- Go to Niural Pay → Bills → Add bill. You can use the Upload vendor invoice panel on the right to automatically extract vendor, amount, dates, and other details by dropping a file (JPEG, PNG, or PDF up to 10MB). The rest can be checked and confirmed.
- To fill manually:
  1) Choose the vendor you want to pay, or + Add new vendor.
  2) Pick the Contract to bill against (this enables anomaly checks where a contract exists).
  3) Entity and department.
  4) Invoice details: Invoice number (vendor’s own), Invoice date, Invoice currency, Due date.
  5) Line items: Item, Quantity, Rate, Tax %, Discount %, Amount. Add more items as needed; totals update automatically.
  6) Add Notes (up to 500 characters) and any Additional attachments.
  7) Click Next: Review details, check the summary, and confirm.

- After saving, the bill appears with its own Invoice ID alongside the vendor’s number. If an approval policy applies, it lands under Needs approval; otherwise it moves toward Ready for payment. Paying is a separate step—open the bill and use Pay invoice.
